success.description: M You call upon the power of the Dark gods as you attack. As the runes of Chaos inscribed on your weapon taste the blood of your enemy, they glow with searing energy in answer to your prayers. You hit the target, either the Cowed or Rattled condition (your choice) for 1 round
As above, and the target gains the Overwhelmed condition for 1 round

conservative.requirements: Melee weapon, engaged with target. Move the token on the Eye of the Gods tracker 1 space to the left
